reference_verifier.role: TEST ONLY; not Portal Production verifier

coordinator_types.name: AcceptProgramMainAuthorityEvent
docs: Emitted by `accept_program_main_authority`.

coordinator_types.name: CallbackAccount
docs: One account the Coordinator passes to a consumer's callback, in the order the consumer listed them. 33 bytes.

coordinator_types.name: CallbackSpec
docs: What the consumer's callback should receive (Callback mode).

fields.name: discriminator
docs: The consumer instruction the Coordinator calls (its Anchor discriminator).

fields.name: compute
docs: Compute units the oracle must budget for the callback: the consumer's measured cost plus a margin. At most
Config's `max_callback_compute`.

fields.name: accounts
docs: The accounts the callback receives after the callback signer, in order. At most 16.

fields.name: args
docs: Arguments appended to the callback's data, already Borsh-encoded. At most 64 bytes.

coordinator_types.name: CancelProgramMainAuthorityEvent
docs: Emitted by `cancel_program_main_authority`. `canceled_pending_main_signing_authority` is `None` when nothing was
pending; the cancel still succeeds.

fields.name: proof
docs: The oracle's VRF proof for the request's alpha under the request's key: 80 bytes for suite 1

fields.name: operations_authority
docs: The hot key, written straight into the config. A param rather than a signer, so a KMS-held key never has to
take part in deployment.

coordinator_types.name: Mode
docs: How a request receives its number.

coordinator_types.name: ProgramConfigAccount
docs: The singleton holding the program's governance state and the VRF settings each new request copies.
Requests only read it and never write it, so requests from different programs never contend for this account.
Layout: append-only, with `version` at offset 8 forever. Borsh writes `None` as a single byte, so every field after
`pending_main_signing_authority` sits 32 bytes earlier while no handover is pending. Decode it with the IDL; never
read fields past `main_signing_authority` at fixed offsets.
PDA: seeds = [PROGRAM_CONFIG_ACCOUNT_PREFIX]

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version. Fixed at offset 8 forever: never move this field.

fields.name: last_block_timestamp
docs: Unix time of the last change to this account.

fields.name: main_signing_authority
docs: The multisig: every setting, any status change, the operations authority, and the handover.

fields.name: pending_main_signing_authority
docs: The successor named by `transfer_program_main_authority`, cleared by accept or cancel. The current main
authority keeps full power until the successor accepts.

fields.name: operations_authority
docs: The hot key (KMS-held). It may replace the fulfiller set and raise the status, never lower it. Always set: to
stand it down, rotate it to a key nobody holds.

fields.name: program_status
docs: The halt level; see `ProgramStatus`.

fields.name: vrf_key
docs: The oracle's VRF public key (a compressed edwards25519 point). All zero until `update_vrf_key` sets it.

fields.name: suite
docs: The VRF suite: `UNCONFIGURED_SUITE` until `update_vrf_key` sets it.

fields.name: fulfillers
docs: The keys allowed to call `fulfill`. Only the first `fulfiller_count` entries count; the rest stay default.

fields.name: fulfiller_count
docs: How many entries of `fulfillers` are set.

fields.name: fee_lamports
docs: The fee per request, paid to the fulfiller that answers it. 0 until `update_request_fee` sets it.

fields.name: default_deadline_slots
docs: The deadline, in slots after the request, used when a request names none.

fields.name: min_deadline_slots
docs: The shortest deadline a request may name, in slots.

fields.name: max_deadline_slots
docs: The longest deadline a request may name, in slots.

fields.name: max_callback_compute
docs: The most compute units a consumer's callback may declare.

fields.name: bump
docs: Canonical bump of this PDA, stored at initialize so later instructions re-derive the address without a search.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved for future fields. Paid once on a singleton, it turns the next field addition into an in-place patch
instead of a realloc instruction.

coordinator_types.name: ProgramStatus
docs: How far the program is halted (architecture §10), from least to most severe.
- `Normal`: everything runs.
- `RequestsHalted`: `request_random` is refused; pending requests are still answered.
- `Halted`: `request_random` and `fulfill` are refused; pending requests expire and refund.
Refund paths (`expire`, `close_request`) and the admin instructions are never gated, so a halt cannot trap a fee
or rent, and un-halting and key rotation keep working while halted.

coordinator_types.name: RandomExpired
docs: Emitted by `expire`: nobody answered in time. The fee went back to `fee_refunded_to` (the fee payer, or the rent
payer when the fee payer was emptied since its request) and the rent to `rent_payer`; the consumer was not called.

fields.name: caller
docs: Whoever sent `expire`: anyone may.

fields.name: rent_refunded
docs: Every lamport left in the request account after the fee, returned as it closed.

fields.name: fee_refunded_to
docs: Where the fee went: `fee_payer`, unless it could not take it (emptied below the rent-exempt minimum), then
`rent_payer`.

coordinator_types.name: RandomFulfilled
docs: Emitted by `fulfill`. With the proof and `RandomRequested`'s alpha, anyone can re-check the number after the
request account has closed.

fields.name: output
docs: The 64-byte VRF output, as the consumer received it (Callback mode) or the request stores it (Store mode).

fields.name: fee_paid
docs: The escrowed fee, paid to the fulfiller.

fields.name: rent_refunded
docs: Callback mode: the rent returned to `rent_payer` as the request closed. Store mode: 0, the rent stays until
`close_request`.

coordinator_types.name: RandomRequested
docs: Emitted by `request_random`. Carries everything needed to rebuild and check alpha after the request account has
closed: the request address, the seed, both slots and the slot hash (F-3).

coordinator_types.name: RequestAccount
docs: One request for a random number. Its address is its id everywhere: in events, in the callback, and in the oracle's
API.
Sized to its callback when it is created: `space(callback_accounts, callback_args)`, from 401 bytes (Store mode) to
993 (16 accounts, 64 bytes of args). The fixed fields come first so their offsets never move: `version` at 8 and
`status` at 9 forever, then the variable-length callback lists last.
PDA: seeds = [REQUEST_ACCOUNT_PREFIX, requester, request_key]

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version. Fixed at offset 8 forever: never move this field.

fields.name: status
docs: Fixed at offset 9 forever: the oracle filters on it.

fields.name: last_block_timestamp
docs: Unix time of the last change to this account.

fields.name: requester
docs: The consumer program (Callback mode), or the app's wallet (Store mode).

fields.name: request_key
docs: Chosen by the requester. One open request per requester and key.

fields.name: seed
docs: The requester's input to the VRF.

fields.name: request_slot
docs: The slot the request landed in.

fields.name: hash_slot
docs: The newest SlotHashes entry when the request landed: unknown until the slot before it was produced.

fields.name: alpha
docs: The VRF input (architecture §9), built from the fields above.

fields.name: vrf_key
docs: The VRF key and suite copied from Config when the request landed. A later key change never affects it.

fields.name: deadline_slot
docs: The last slot in which `fulfill` is accepted.

fields.name: fee
docs: The fee, escrowed in this account on top of its rent.

fields.name: fee_payer
docs: Gets the fee back if the request expires, unless emptied by then (the fee then goes to `rent_payer`).

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Gets the rent back when the request closes.

fields.name: callback_discriminator
docs: Callback mode: the consumer instruction to call, and the compute the oracle must budget for it.

fields.name: output
docs: Store mode: the number once answered, and the slot it was answered in.

fields.name: bump
docs: Canonical bump of this PDA.

fields.name: callback_accounts
docs: Callback mode: the accounts passed to the callback, in callback order (at most 16). Variable length: last.

fields.name: callback_args
docs: Callback mode: the callback's arguments, already Borsh-encoded (at most 64 bytes). Variable length: last.

coordinator_types.name: RequestClosed
docs: Emitted by `close_request`. The number itself stays public in `RandomFulfilled`.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Where the rent went: the request's `rent_payer`.

fields.name: rent_refunded
docs: Every lamport the request account held as it closed.

fields.name: request_key
docs: Chosen by the requester; one open request per requester and key. Part of the request's address.

fields.name: seed
docs: The requester's own input to the VRF.

fields.name: deadline_slots
docs: Slots after this one in which the request may be answered. `None` takes Config's default.

fields.name: callback
docs: Callback mode: the callback. Store mode: none.

coordinator_types.name: RequestStatus
docs: Where a request is in its life. Stored at byte offset 9 of the request account, forever: the oracle finds open
requests by filtering on it.

coordinator_types.name: TransferProgramMainAuthorityEvent
docs: Emitted by `transfer_program_main_authority`. A transfer replaces any successor already pending; that one is
`previous_pending_main_signing_authority`.

fields.name: new_main_signing_authority
docs: The proposed successor. It takes over only when it signs `accept_program_main_authority`.

coordinator_types.name: UpdateFulfillersEvent
docs: Emitted by `update_fulfillers`. The sets are the active ones (the first `fulfiller_count` entries).

fields.name: signer
docs: The main authority or the operations authority, whichever signed.

fields.name: fulfillers
docs: The complete new set: at most 4 distinct, non-default keys. It replaces the current set entirely; an empty set
stands every fulfiller down.

coordinator_types.name: UpdateOperationsAuthorityEvent
docs: Emitted by `update_operations_authority`. On a no-op rotation `previous` equals `new`.

fields.name: new_operations_authority
docs: The new hot key. A param rather than a signer, so a KMS-held key never has to sign its own appointment. There
is no unset state: to stand the role down, rotate it to a key nobody holds.

coordinator_types.name: UpdateProgramStatusEvent
docs: Emitted by `update_program_status`.

fields.name: signer
docs: The main authority or the operations authority, whichever signed.

coordinator_types.name: UpdateRequestFeeEvent
docs: Emitted by `update_request_fee`.

fields.name: fee_lamports
docs: The fee, in lamports, each new request pays to the fulfiller that answers it. At most 0.1 SOL.

coordinator_types.name: UpdateRequestLimitsEvent
docs: Emitted by `update_request_limits`.

fields.name: default_deadline_slots
docs: The deadline, in slots after the request, used when a request names none.

fields.name: min_deadline_slots
docs: The shortest deadline a request may name, in slots. At least 2.

fields.name: max_deadline_slots
docs: The longest deadline a request may name, in slots. At most 1,000.

fields.name: max_callback_compute
docs: The most compute units a consumer's callback may declare. At most 1,200,000.

coordinator_types.name: UpdateVrfKeyEvent
docs: Emitted by `update_vrf_key`.

fields.name: vrf_key
docs: The oracle's VRF public key: a compressed edwards25519 point for suite 1.

fields.name: suite
docs: The VRF suite; 1 (RFC 9381 ECVRF-EDWARDS25519-SHA512-TAI) is the only one in v1.

callback.writable_rule: outer may promote stored readonly; CPI uses stored writability

lifecycle.model: one request PDA per requester/key; no arena queue or delegation ABI
lifecycle.callback_success: fee to fulfiller; close request; rent to recorded rent_payer
lifecycle.verifier_return: pinned verifier program ID and exactly 64 bytes
